It prints general GE policy and the LACCD General Education Plan area lists (heading 'TYPES OF GENERAL EDUCATION'), which is a different pattern; those area lists were not recorded as IGETC requirements.

Page 55 mentions a 'Certificate of Achievement in IGETC' only in passing (students awarded it meet associate degree GE requirements); no requirements, total units, outcomes or careers for the IGETC certificate are printed.
Reviewer should fetch the actual IGETC certificate page/section of the 2026-2027 LATTC catalog; many closed-list courses appear in the LACCD GE area lists and would likely map to IGETC areas there.
LACCD GE plan states 'General Education Requirements: Minimimum 27 semester units' — that belongs to the LACCD GE plan, not this award, so it was not recorded.
